confirmed_open.description: TASK_STATE.md and HANDOFF.md are not protected by a single paired-write protocol. Their history contains stale checkpoints; the latest verified repository state must be compared with checkpoint metadata before resuming.

A report that was never durably written to the repository cannot be reconstructed verbatim after a network interruption. Future work must persist concise checkpoints after each material verified milestone and distinguish persisted records from undelivered response text.

The ChatGPT web extension is a prototype verified by static CI only. Must be installed and tested in the user's actual Yandex Browser Android version. Verify send gate (no send before durable receipt), exact text and prior assistant message capture, interrupted connection recovery, response DOM detection, multiple incomplete turns, extension restart, and UI-selector drift.
